reviews.comment: The class is broken up into 3 separate categories. Engineering Economics, Optimization, and Sustainability. Three test and no final. All homework's, quizzes and test are based on lectures and past assignments. Cheat sheets are extremely helpful on exams.

He's super nice and really wants you to learn. He's good at responding to emails and extended homework deadlines frequently. The quizzes and exams are a big part of the grade, but he gives solutions to the homework which are similar to exam problems. He posts slides and that's really all you need to know. Homework is weekly and not too long.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Quadrifoglio has great notes. He teaches well and cares about if his students learn. The topics can be complex but his examples are excellent guides to use for the homework. He is a fair grader and allows cheat sheets. Great prof overall.

Quadrifoglio has very clear online notes which make learning the material easy. His homework usually takes a couple of hours and was easy to figure out. You do have to code , but just use the code from the lecture as a template. He allowed cheat sheets on the test and the problems were plug and chug. He can be sassy if you ask dumb questions.

Dr. Luca is a great choice for CVEN 322. He is very straightforward in the way his lectures, quizzes, and tests are laid out. He's very passionate about the topics in this course (more so than for CVEN 302), and all of his lecture slides and homework solutions are posted on Canvas.

The lectures at times could get pretty boring but he graded all assignments fairly and gave reasonable homework. He is accessible outside of class and it's clear that he wants his students to understand the material and do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I liked him better for 302 than 322 but he still was a good professor for both. Exams make up about 60% of the grade. Weekly homework's that aren't incredibly hard but he is always extremely responsive to emails if you need any help for anything.
Professor Quadrifoglio is one of the best professors I have had at A&M. He is quick to respond to emails and his lectures are very helpful. Definitely recommend for CVEN 302.

One of the most fair and clear professors ever. Exams closely follow homework and/or lectures and homework is easy to follow from lecture examples. He is also just a nice guy in general and I genuinely enjoyed his class.

Lectures are straightforward and the notes and PowerPoints he teaches with are incredibly thorough and pretty much walk you through how to do everything on the homeworks including the Python code. Easier class but tests are 30% of your grade. Definitely recommend.
Very nice professor, simple and no bad surprises. The lectures are heavy but his exams are open notes and based on homework problems. Easy A if you are consistent.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was supposed to be an easy A, but this was his first time teaching it. It really wasn't tough, but the final is 40% of the grade, so unless you ace it, you'll get a B most likely. Homework takes some time, but not bad. He will definitely help you.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He curves up & teaches the stuff well. The class is boring but he's the best guy to take for it.

Be ready to do the hardest hw assignments you've seen so far. He is a nice guy and very understanding but his lectures don't help a lot. The first test is pretty easy but the 2ndtest/final is insane. The class is pretty tough with a lot of material covered so pay attention.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are nice, simple, and to the point. Keeps focused on the important material and makes it clear what you need to know for the tests. Tests and homework are easy if you put just put a little bit of effort into it.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
